purpose: Prevent LOTERIAS AI from treating every Must-Hit-By / Must-Win-By progressive as the same stochastic mechanism. Public regulatory, patent, manufacturer and independent-analysis sources show materially different implementations, so mechanism identity must be verified before converting a displayed cap into EV.

sources.productFamily: Light & Wonder Atlas progressive table-game system
supportedFacts: The optional MHB progressive is an add-on to an existing Atlas progressive wager; no additional wager is required to qualify.
The meter increments from a configured increment rate and the total value of progressive wagers.
Each participating player is assigned an RNG value and wins if it falls below a calculated threshold tied to the current progressive value.
The odds of the MHB award increase as the progressive value passes certain thresholds.
The patent describes mystery progressive systems in which an RNG can select a hidden award level inside a published range whose upper endpoint is the must-hit-by value.
It gives an illustrative $10,000-$20,000 range with a hidden selected level such as $17,200.
The same patent also discusses alternative game-determined/value-dependent must-win-by mechanisms.
The product can feature a posted Must Hit By amount.
The MHB amount may be awarded at the end of a round to a player making the optional progressive wager.
The rack card directs the player to posted paytables for odds rather than publishing the MHB odds in the rack card itself.
The profile describes two mystery Must Hit By jackpots.
The secondary resets at $200 and must hit by $500.
The top progressive resets at $4,000 and must hit by $5,000.
The analysis treats many manufacturers' mystery MHB jackpots as approximately uniform hidden thresholds but explicitly warns that AGS behaves differently.

It reports a River Dragons example whose $4,000-$5,000 top jackpot has a calculated average hit level near $4,945.49, strongly inconsistent with a uniform $4,000-$5,000 hidden threshold whose mean would be $4,500.

requiredBeforeUniformThresholdEV: uniform hidden threshold distribution verified for that exact configuration
meter increment caused by the player's wager verified
base RTP excluding the MHB component verified
requiredBeforeStagedHazardEV: current stage/value-dependent award probability per eligible wager verified
base RTP excluding the MHB component verified

implementationImpact.forbiddenPromotion: Never promote a displayed MHB cap to executable EV by assuming alpha=1/uniform or any fitted alpha without exact mechanism evidence.

decision.reason: Mechanism taxonomy improved, but no exact currently-live game configuration in the repository has all distribution, eligibility, meter-increment and base-RTP inputs verified.
